title: Basics of Electronic Displays
src: R.K. Bali — Air Navigation, Part II Ch 9 (questions that need the book's diagrams are left out)

qs.q: The Primary Flight Display (PFD) displays information dedicated to:

Regarding the Electronic Flight Instrument System (EFIS): 1. the Navigation Display (ND) displays flight director bars 2. the altimeter setting is displayed on the PFD 3. the PFD is the main flying instrument 4. the FMA (flight mode annunciator) is part of the ND. The combination of correct statements is:
Which colours are typically used on an EHSI?
o: Black, blue, purple, red, green and white.
White, green, magenta, cyan, yellow and red.

The wind direction symbol displayed all EHSI modes except PLAN mode is oriented:
o: to grid north when flying at high latitudes.

qs.q: On a HSI map mode, distance to go is displayed in the:
Which of the following displays are part of the Electronic Flight Instrument System (Boeing)?
o: Navigation Display and Primary Flight Display
ND and Electronic Attitude Director Indicator
Electronic Attitude Director Indicator and Electronic Horizontal Situation Indicator

qs.q: Decision height is displayed on the:
o: EHSI in Map mode, and below 1000 ft is shown as a circular display which is erased anticlockwise as the aircraft descends
EADI, and below 800 ft changes to a circular scale which is white with a magenta DH marker
EADI, and below 1000 ft is shown as a circular scale which is erased anticlockwise as the aircraft descends

qs.q: At what height does the DH, on the EADI display, starts flashing yellow?
In addition to attitude and auto flight modes, what information is also typically displayed on an EADI?
o: Speed, Altitude, ILS localiser and glide slope information, and sometimes also heading information.
Altitude, speed and sometimes also heading information.

qs.q: WXR display is controlled from:
o: both captains and co-pilots EHSI control panels

qs.q: Aircraft electronic display systems normally incorporate:
o: one symbol generator for each CRT.
a single CRT for each pilot position.

qs.q: The weather radar display data can be shown on:
o: only one EHSI at a time.
the Captain's and First Officer's EHSI simultaneously.

qs.q: With an EFIS flight director using EFIS guidance, reference north can be:
o: magnetic north between 73° N and 65° S and true north above these latitudes
magnetic north between 65° N and 73° S and true north above these latitudes

qs.q: When using EHSI, weather radar may be displayed on following settings:
Decision height is adjusted and set on the:
o: ADI section of the EFIS control panel

qs.q: The heading reference used on the EHSI is:
Decision height is …
o: displayed on the EADI using FMC inputs.
calculated by the flight management computer.
displayed on the EADI, and set by the pilot using the EFIS control panel.

The speed tape on an EADI is located:
o: on the left-hand side of the HSI
on the left-hand side of the EADI
on the right-hand side of the EADI

qs.q: On an EHSI display, wind velocity can be displayed in which of the following modes?
o: Map, Plan, Full ILS and Full VOR.
Map, Expanded ILS, Full ILS and Full VOR.
Plan, Full ILS, Expanded VOR and Full VOR.

qs.q: The function of EICAS is to:
o: show check lists on the left display and systems diagrams on the right display.
show engine primary indications on the upper display and engine secondary indications on the lower display.
show engine primary indications on the left display and engine secondary indications on the right display.
